title: docs(skills): owner_id in the session-token filter example, bound user id in the hook find example
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JvBUHu5JZehUFbNWsJ7EFW)_

Fixes #33730
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个已发布技能文档里的查询示例。filters.md 的会话令牌示例从 `owner` 改为平台的归属列 `owner_id`；data-hooks.md 的 `find` 示例先从钩子上下文取 `ctx.session?.userId` 绑定到 `uid`，取不到就提前返回，不再用未定义的变量。
- 为什么改：PR #33726 复审指出这两个示例照抄会出错：`owner` 列平台并不提供，`uid` 是个未定义变量。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档示例和一个 patch changeset，不动代码；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` 第 298–300 行，`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` 第 166 与 176 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期两个文件都在上限内（filters.md 2469/2473，data-hooks.md 10003/10011）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`: the session-token example now filters `owner_id: '{current_user_id}'`. `owner_id` is the platform's provisioned ownership column (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:1643-1649`, auto-added and stamped to the acting user on insert by SecurityPlugin; the doc block at `registry.ts:1334-1338` names it the canonical reassignable owner). The tokens' own source uses the same example (`packages/spec/src/data/context-tokens.zod.ts:27`). The surrounding "Session tokens" paragraph still reads true and is unchanged.
- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`: the `find` example's unbound `uid` is now bound from the hook context before the read: `const uid = ctx.session?.userId;` then `if (!uid) return;`, and the `find` line itself is unchanged. The hook context names the caller's id `HookContext.session.userId` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts:1411-1412`: `session: z.object({ userId: z.string().optional(), …`), and the retired-roles prescription at `hook.zod.ts:1617` says "read `ctx.session.userId` / `ctx.session.isSystem`". Optional chaining because the same file teaches that `ctx.session` is absent on system writes; the example returns early when there is no id.
- `.changeset/33730-skills-query-hook-examples.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Tests

Docs-only diff; no test file is touched and no forced test edit exists. No eval prompt is added: both edits correct an existing example and add no new teaching.

Readings on origin/main `f81e4b6c` (before) and this head (after):

| File | Lines | Bytes | Tokens / ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` | 209 → 208 | 9892 → 9876 | 2473 → 2469 / 2473 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` | 893 → 895 | 39960 → 40011 | 9990 → 10003 / 10011 |
| Whole package, sum of all `SKILL.md` | 4596 → 4596 | — | — |
| Whole shipped bundle (ratchet total) | — | — | 246787 → 246796 |

No ratchet row moved. filters.md sat at zero headroom, so the 3 bytes of the `owner_id` rename are paid in place: the Parameterised-tokens bullet drops its third restatement of `{30_days_ago}` (the token keeps its homes at line 71 and in the code example at line 157 of the same file). Net, filters.md is 16 bytes smaller (9892 → 9876). data-hooks.md's two new lines fit its existing headroom; nothing was cut there.

## Acceptance notes

- Authored by an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to the contract-review tier on this branch, because this thread is served below the tier `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates for `skills/**`; the thread did the push, gates and relay. The seat agreed this route before the claim.
- The changeset body opens with the two declaration lines and carries no title line.
- Review round 1 (contract review record 6900946687): the hook example now reads the id first and returns early without one. A security item is with the owner seat.
